errors.text_span: The chart features four groups of bars, each representing a different SFT configuration
errors.evidence: The chart has three groups of bars, one for each model on the x-axis (LLaMA-2-7B, LLaMA-2-13B, LLaMA-2-70B). Within each group, there are four bars, with each bar representing a different SFT configuration.
The highest value reached by any bar in the chart is approximately 84% (for LLaMA-2-13B with +SFT on D0, D1). No bar reaches 87%.

errors.text_span: and 87% for LLaMA-2-13B and LLaMA-2-70B with + SFT on D0, D1, D2
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies the condition for the tallest bar for the LLaMA-2-13B model. The tallest bar in that group corresponds to '+ SFT on D0, D1' (the purple bar, approx. 84%), not '+ SFT on D0, D1, D2' (the red bar, approx. 80%).

The description mentions the colors of the bars but fails to describe the different fill patterns (diagonal stripes, horizontal stripes, solid fill) which are a key visual feature used to distinguish the categories in the legend.
